id                   String                   @id @default(cuid())

id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  groupId      String?  @map("group_id")
  /// Top-level category surfaced in the templates list filters (usually = department).
  category     String?  @map("category")
  /// One of "role-based" | "remote" | "leadership". Optional; filter can also fall back to heuristics.
  templateType String?  @map("template_type")
  /// One of "beginner" | "intermediate" | "advanced".
  complexity   String?  @map("complexity")
  /// Owning department (Engineering, Design, HR, …). Drives the Department filter on the templates list.
  department   String?  @map("department")
  stagesJson   Json?    @map("stages_json")
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  candidates OnboardingCandidate[]

  @@index([category])
  @@index([templateType])
  @@index([complexity])
  @@index([department])

id           String         @id @default(cuid())
  /// Unique tag used on the asset (e.g. LAP-001).
  assetTag     String         @unique @map("asset_tag") @db.VarChar(64)
  /// Display name (e.g. MacBook Pro M2).
  name         String
  /// Model / variant line (optional; may match name).
  model        String?        @db.VarChar(255)
  /// Manufacturer serial; unique when set.
  serialNumber String?        @unique @map("serial_number") @db.VarChar(128)
  categoryId   String?        @map("category_id")
  condition    AssetCondition @default(NEW)
  status       AssetStatus    @default(AVAILABLE)

  vendorId         String?   @map("vendor_id")
  /// Purchase / financial
  purchaseOrder    String?   @map("purchase_order") @db.VarChar(128)
  invoiceNumber    String?   @map("invoice_number") @db.VarChar(128)
  purchaseDate     DateTime? @map("purchase_date") @db.Date
  purchaseValue    Decimal?  @map("purchase_value") @db.Decimal(14, 2)
  /// Useful life in months (e.g. 36).
  usefulLifeMonths Int?      @map("useful_life_months")
  warrantyEndDate  DateTime? @map("warranty_end_date") @db.Date

  /// Location & assignment line (e.g. desk, site, or “Remote — Priya”).
  location     String  @db.VarChar(512)
  departmentId String? @map("department_id")
  notes        String  @db.Text

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  category            AssetCategory?       @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  vendor              AssetVendor?         @relation(fields: [vendorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  department          Department?          @relation(fields: [departmentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  assignments         AssetAssignment[]
  lostDamageIncidents LostDamageIncident[]
  photos              AssetPhoto[]

  @@index([categoryId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([vendorId])
  @@index([departmentId])
  @@map("Asset")
